rows.note: Use this for an insurance policy, whether you mean the contract or the document proving it.

example.english: I can't find my insurance policy.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 m4 faan1 zoeng1 bou2 daan1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an official policy adopted by a government or organization.

example.english: The government announced a new policy.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gung1 bou3 zo2 san1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this for the guiding direction or approach behind an organization's policy rather than its formally announced measures.

example.english: The company's policy for the next few years is to reduce waste.
example.traditional: 公司未來幾年嘅方針係減少浪費。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 mei6 loi4 gei2 nin4 ge3 fong1 zam1 hai6 gaam2 siu2 long6 fai3

rows.note: Use this when policy means the document that sets out an official policy.

example.english: Please read this policy document first.
example.traditional: 請先睇吓呢份政策文件。
example.jyutping: cing2 sin1 tai2 haa5 ni1 fan6 zing3 caak3 man4 gin6
